product_one_liner.value: Upstage builds enterprise AI products—including Solar large language models, document-processing tools, and Studio agents—to automate document-heavy workflows for businesses.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its products as LLMs and document-processing engines for business workflows.

pricing_page.notes: Public pages publish API and Studio pricing.

named_customers.notes: Each is presented on an Upstage customer-story page.

employee_band.notes: About page states a team of 100+; public LinkedIn company profile categorizes Upstage as 51–200. Its own stated count is 100+, making 51–100 the best-supported available band among the allowed choices.

hq_location.notes: The company lists its address in Gangnam-gu, Seoul, and identifies Seoul as its base.

founded_year.notes: The About page says founded in 2020.

eng_blog.notes: The blog includes multiple engineering/model-development posts, including technical coverage of Solar Pro 3 performance and model design, alongside other technical pieces.

public_docs.notes: The public developer documentation includes multiple guides, model references, API capability articles, and deployment documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers job board is the current open-roles destination; no role list could be extracted from the page accessed, but Upstage is publicly recruiting AI researchers/engineers per company careers materials.

model_provider.value: Upstage's own Solar models; its privacy policy names Fireworks.ai, NAVER Cloud Corp., Tavily, and RunPod among providers used for model inference or related AI services.
model_provider.notes: Documentation identifies the offered Solar models as Upstage models. The privacy policy separately identifies third-party inference providers.

compliance_certs.notes: The page claims SOC 2, HIPAA, and ISO 27001/27701 compliance. Listed only requested certification names; ISO 27701 is not one of the specified options.

last_funding.notes: The April 15, 2026 report describes a $120 million Series C raise. A search result also surfaced a same-day later announcement of a further Series C Round 2 NVIDIA investment, but no amount was available; this is the most recent funding round for which amount and date could both be verified.

raised_18mo.notes: The April 2026 Series C falls within the 18 months before the run date.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The careers landing page directs to an external job board, but the current role titles were not retrievable, so neither a positive nor negative answer can be supported.

launched_6mo.notes: Solar Open 2 was announced July 22, 2026, and Solar Pro 4 was announced in August 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated evidence establishing a C-level or VP-level join/departure in the period was found; available team/about material is insufficient to verify a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy names Attio for CRM and Apollo.io for lead management and data enrichment.
